cohort: Preterm newborns (30-34 weeks + 6 days gestation) of mothers with and without preeclampsia
finding: Early preeclampsia increases the risk of complications in preterm neonates, including lower birth weight, higher incidence of severe RDS, and increased risk of hematological changes like neutropenia and thrombocytopenia.
mod_finding: Most of the deliveries in the group of newborns exposed to preeclampsia were performed by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Lower in the preterm neonates exposed to preeclampsia
